description: Election Commission - P. M. G. Piyatissa was Selected as the member of the Kundasale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kundasale Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement through established electoral procedures. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
